messages:
ria: Customer C-2048 reporting spikes of 502/504s when doing long streaming requests to hosted API (chat/stream). Started ~2026-03-16 11:03 UTC, ~10% of requests fail.
alex: Can you paste the sample request id / trace? also which model + route?
ria: req_id: r-0a9f3b2c, trace: trace-7yyz; route: /v1/chat.stream, model: open-redwood-3.2. Long-ish context (~4k tokens) + streaming + guest account.
ingrid: Quick check — support dashboard shows a burst at 11:02-11:04 with p95 latency jump, and a few upstream errors labelled "RST_STREAM" at edge.
ria: Copying relevant snippet from customer curl repro:
```
curl -v --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"<large payload>"}], "stream": true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat.stream
```
ria: When they run that repeatedly they see ~1/8 runs end with: "upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. downstream reset" and 504s on retry.
sam: Do we see any Envoy logs for r-0a9f3b2c? I can grep.
alex: I pulled the edge logs: `upstream reset: reason=RST_STREAM, code=2, remote: upstream-collector-ip:443` for r-0a9f3b2c. Also `connection closed before response` around same time.
sam: Looks like HTTP/2 flow-control window exhaustion on midfronts during large streaming batches. We also see concurrent auth-cache misses causing auth tier fanout.
ingrid: Correlated traces show the request hits auth service (latency spike), then midproxy, then upstream; midproxy kept many h2 streams open -> h2 window drift + RSTs.
ria: Customer on support call wants timeline + workaround.
alex: Short-term workaround: reduce simultaneous streaming parallelism or lower chunk size. Also try `Connection: close` or disable multiplexing from client to avoid h2 window saturation.
sam: Mitigation steps we can try from infra: increase h2 initial window on midproxy for the tenant-range, or enable per-conn stream limits. I'm going to test a conservative increase in initial window on a canary node.
support-bot: Deploy started: canary-midproxy-window-increase @infra-team
ingrid: Also adding a rule to route heavy streaming guests to dedicated pool with larger conn limits while we investigate.
ria: I'll relay this to the customer and get them to try the client-side change.
alex: Logging TODOs: add more granular h2 window/bytes-sent metrics, surface auth-cache miss rate per tenant in console, and tag traces where RST_STREAM occurred.
sam: For postmortem: check if auth rotation around 11:00 caused transient fanout; also validate keepalive settings between edge and midproxy.
ria: Thanks — will update ticket. If the canary change helps, please ping this thread and I'll coordinate rollback plan for global.
alex: Noted. tagging eng-oncall for visibility @eng-oncall
support-bot: Alert created: INC-2026-0316-504STREAM (linked to C-2048)
ria: closing interim update — customer is trying client tweak now, will report back in 30m.
